items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public launch and rights-dependent monetization; conditional for ordinary reversible growth within existing consent, disclosure, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and data-handling boundaries. Evidence: Woot public terms do not establish commercial or public redistribution rights; 0 of 4 SearchWoot legal tasks are closed; accuracy/freshness, security, measurement, and attribution gates remain blocked; compliance is technical-only with 37 pass, 15 fail, and 7 unknown. Incomplete telemetry alone does not block ordinary growth. Exact decision: keep searchwoot.com private, keep external permission outreach unsent, and authorize only bounded read-only evidence work. No go-live proposal is supported.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. No task is closable on current evidence. Open tasks: searchwoot-legal-source-rights, searchwoot-data-flow-retention, searchwoot-ga4-consent-evidence, and searchwoot-logs-vendors-incident. Progress is limited to partial source, repository, privacy-policy, and cookie-policy evidence already recorded. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering provenance, permitted storage, caching, display, derivatives, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor coverage, and incident/request procedures. Do not close tasks without attached evidence.

Data-use dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data—counsel_required; missing written permission or an API agreement, field-level provenance and rights, permitted storage, caching, display, derivatives, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark, image, price, affiliate, and advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel review. User alert rules and sync results—evidence_needed; missing data inventory, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce the repository and deployed data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics—evidence_needed; missing deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property and data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional treatment. Smallest next action: capture existing consent and GA4 configuration without enabling tracking or advertising. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data—evidence_needed; missing log-field inventory, retention and access controls, vendor/DPA review, incident handling, and data-request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only operator/vendor inventory and identify counsel-required gaps.

Site and fleet triage: retain site-specific remediation or evidence gates for compliance failures and unknowns. Do not infer regulated, adult, or age-sensitive status from domain names. Affiliate disclosures, claims, copyright/trademark provenance, consent, cookie/analytics disclosures, and platform-policy compliance must remain within evidenced boundaries before monetization or exposure. Parked or scaffold sites require a concrete launch decision and completed checklist before launch; incomplete telemetry is not itself a blocker for ordinary reversible work.
